newsitem.title: USA: NEOPROBE SEES RIGSCAN DECISIONS BY YR END.
newsitem.headline: NEOPROBE SEES RIGSCAN DECISIONS BY YR END.

text.p: Neoprobe Corp said Monday it expects final marketing approval decisions before the end of this year from regulatory agencies in the United States and Europe for its RIGScan CR49 for use with company's gamma-detecting probe to help surgeons find cancer during surgery.
Neoprobe said it has opened a compassionate use program with RIGScan CR49 for metastatic colorectal cancer to make the product available while it is pending marketing approval decisions.

The company also said it is opening a Phase II multicenter study with RIGScan CR49 for patients with other adenocarcinomas, or cancers that originate in glandular organs, including ovarian, endometrial, pancreatic and stomach cancers.
